title: Line heat source in a cylinder: logarithmic profile (analytic)
description:
Steady conduction from a line source (point_heat_source) at the centre of a cylinder whose outside (everything beyond r_wall) is held at T_wall.
Analytic: T = T_wall + P / (2 pi k) ln(r_wall / r).
Derived values tab: theta_near (r = 4 cells) and theta_far (r = 36 cells) from the two probes against the log law; staircase wall and lattice errors, expect < 1 %.
Line profile tab: T_radial (T from one cell beside the source out to the wall); the first cell beside the source sits ~1 % of the rise off the log law (lattice Green's function), further out < 0.5 %.

parameters.name: P_line
parameters.description: line source power in W per m of z

parameters.name: k_med
parameters.description: thermal conductivity in W/(m K) (an insulating solid)

parameters.name: T_wall
parameters.description: temperature held outside r_wall in K

parameters.name: xc
parameters.description: source x: a cell centre near the domain centre

parameters.name: r_wall
parameters.description: radius of the held cylinder wall

parameters.name: r_near
parameters.description: radius of the near probe (a cell centre on the source row)

parameters.name: r_far
parameters.description: radius of the far probe (a cell centre on the source row)
